verdict.rationale: First-party docs say users can 'secure your data with Postman Vault', which points to a local secret store that keeps credentials out of shared workspace and collection files. This is a single thin mention, plus bare links to Environments and Variables docs, with no detail on how it works. A community claim that Postman uploads secrets to its servers is general and unspecific, so it lowers confidence rather than creating a dispute. Missing for 10: documented secret masking in environments, external vault integration (e.g. HashiCorp, AWS, Azure secret managers), detail on how Vault secrets are excluded from synced or shared files, independent hands-on corroboration.
